artworks.title: Apollo
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Anonymous gift in honor of Philip Hofer
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a contrapposto position. The individual has a muscular build with detailed torso and limbs. They have curly hair flowing over their shoulders and are draped in a long fabric. The background is a plain surface with line detailing at the feet. The image is a detailed line drawing with cross-hatching.

artworks.title: God the Father in Glory
artworks.artist: Attributed to Andrea Boscoli after Michelangelo
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of figures, with a central horizontal figure extending an arm forward. The figure has long flowing hair and a beard. There are other figures partially visible, including one with a distinct facial profile and another child-like figure on the right side. The figures are shown in the nude amidst cloud-like forms, creating a dynamic sense. The background is a light, monotone paper with delicately rendered outlines, void of color.

artworks.title: Rudolf I and Albert I with Pallas
artworks.artist: Sir Peter Paul Rubens and Theodoor van Thulden
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with white oil paint over red chalk on oiled paper; verso incised for transfer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three statues within an architectural setting. The central figure is depicted as an ancient warrior goddess holding a shield and a spear, flanked by male warrior statues on pedestals. The drawing is rendered in shades of brown, with intricate architectural details such as columns and archways framing the statues. Delicate patterns adorn the background. The armor, clothing, and facial features are detailed, capturing a sense of grandeur.

artworks.title: Draftsmen Outdoors
artworks.medium: black chalk and stumping on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows four individuals with visible full bodies. On the left side, two people are sitting on the ground, leaning back with one foot extended and the other bent. They have facial features, curly hair, and loose, flowing clothing. To their right, two more individuals are sitting under a large umbrella, engaged in an activity involving a large sheet or blanket over a basket. These two individuals have long hair and wear long-sleeved garments. There are sketchy plant forms in the background to suggest an outdoor setting.

artworks.title: Wooded Upland Landscape with a Bridge
artworks.medium: black and white chalk with gray and black wash heightened with white on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated perspective. The terrain is gently rolling with a low horizon line and hints of distant hills. In the foreground, there is a path with two figures walking, bordered by trees with dense foliage. A rustic bridge crosses a stream on the left. The painting style is fluid and loose, with a monochromatic color palette of gray tones creating a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Seated Woman Sewing
artworks.medium: red chalk
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting in a chair, holding a small piece of fabric or paper. She has a serene expression and curly hair. She wears an elegant dress and a decorative headpiece. In the background are a book and a piece of cloth.

artworks.title: Scene on the South Coast of England
artworks.medium: black chalk with gray wash heightened with white on green paper
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape view from an elevated perspective. The horizon line separates the sea and sky. There are subtle indications of vessels or features in the distance. The sketch features light pencil strokes, creating a delicate texture. The color palette is primarily beige and gray. The shoreline curves gently with a rocky texture depicted by denser pencil lines. The sky has wispy clouds depicted with horizontal pencil lines.

artworks.title: Studies of Nude Dancers
artworks.medium: graphite and watercolor
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Frank Eyerly
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a reclining nude female figure. The figure is portrayed with her back arched, arms extended backward, and knees bent. Her head is tilted back with subtle facial features. Long dark hair cascades backward. The sketch uses minimalistic lines and shading. No clothing or accessories are present. In the background, there are faint sketches of other figures in dynamic poses. The background is plain and neutral.

artworks.title: Woman in Court Dress
artworks.medium: graphite with stump
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth B. Benedict in memory of her parents, Sophie and Carl Boschwitz
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from their head to mid-torso. The person is in a reclined pose with their head turned to the side. The face features a prominent nose and closed lips, seen in a three-quarter view. The person has curly hair. They wear an off-the-shoulder dress with ruffled edges and intricate patterns. The background is plain, emphasizing the person and their clothing texture.

artworks.title: Evening
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on Japanese paper
artworks.description: The artwork displays a tranquil landscape with a pastoral scene viewed from an elevated perspective. A serene stream reflects the sky, with two cows and a woman nearby. Further away, a group of cattle and people are seen on lush grassland. The horizon shows distant trees and a textured sky. Soft clouds fill the sky. The image uses fine etching techniques with intricate cross-hatching for texture and depth. The monochromatic palette conveys natural elements and lighting through shading, creating a timeless and contemplative mood.

artworks.title: Murder of Edith Cavell
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene featuring a staircase and several figures in a dimly lit environment. The artwork shows a stone staircase leading downwards with individuals present in the space. The figures are depicted in different poses, some resting on the ground and others standing or sitting. Light sources such as lanterns and lamps illuminate the area, creating a contrast between light and shadow in the architectural elements.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features the upper half of a seated elderly man in a circular frame. He is holding a book with one hand and a large sword with the other. The man has a long beard, deep-set eyes, and a halo above his head. He has short, curly hair on his head and is wearing a loose-fitting garment that covers his shoulders and arms. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: The Raising of Lazarus: Small Plate
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures gathered at the entrance of a cave or tomb, looking towards a person inside. The scene includes detailed linework of the foliage, rocks, and figures' robes. Background shows architectural structures and natural landscape. The composition directs focus towards the central figure with the use of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Banquet at the House of Tarquinius Collatinus
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.9 x 24.7 cm (8 1/4 x 9 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a banquet scene. The scene depicts an elaborately set dining table surrounded by individuals in historical dress engaged in conversation and dining activities. The composition includes decorative walls and arched ceilings. The figures are shown in various poses, some serving wine, others eating, all with intricate garments. The use of shading and line work is meticulous, highlighting expressions and textures, and giving depth to the interior space. The style is reminiscent of a Renaissance or Baroque engraving.

artworks.title: Daniel Heinsius
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 26.5 x 19.7 cm (10 7/16 x 7 3/4 in.)
overall: 86.3 cm (34 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a man with a receding hairline and facial hair, dressed in historical attire posing against a simple textured background.

artworks.title: Dream of a Man Fleeing
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (lunette): 14 x 8.7 cm (5 1/2 x 3 7/16 in.)
support: 30 x 21.5 cm (11 13/16 x 8 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a dynamic pose with one arm raised and bent, head slightly tilted back. The individual wears loose-fitting clothing and a long robe or coat. The person's legs are bent, implying movement. The drawing is made with charcoal and pastel, with contrasting colors used for detail. The background features subtle, textured horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Little Shepherd, 1st Plate (Le Petit Berger)
artworks.medium: cliché-verre
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a forest scene viewed at eye level. The horizon, marked by a line of trees and foliage, is relatively high in the composition. There is a lighter patch of sky on the horizon, possibly suggesting a clearing or valley beyond. The brushstrokes or etched lines are detailed, capturing the intricacies of tree trunks, branches, and leaves. The color palette is limited to sepia tones. A solitary figure stands next to a tree close to the viewer, adding a focal point. The dense canopy of leaves covers the upper section of the image, creating an enclosed feeling in the landscape.

artworks.title: Putti Testing a Man's Perception of Depth
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white, on laid paper; indented with a stylus and chalked for transfer on the verso
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded elderly figure interacting with three cherubic figures with wings in an interior setting that includes a study-like ambiance. The elder figure is seated on a chair adorned with intricate carvings. The posture is one of gesturing, as if conveying a lesson or a story to the three cherubs who are standing in front of a large desk or cabinet. On the desk are objects that resemble celestial spheres or globes. The room has substantial architectural features, with visible columns and detailed woodwork. The entire drawing is rendered in a monochromatic scheme, emphasizing study in tonal values and detailed line work.

artworks.title: Saint Constantine and Saint Elena
artworks.medium: photo-mechanical reproduction
artworks.creditLine: Gift of His Excellency Konstantin N. Grigorov, Ambassador E.and P., Embassy of the People's Republic of Bulgaria
artworks.description: The image shows two figures standing on either side of a large, ornate cross. The figure on the left is a bearded male wearing a crown and a decorated robe, holding a vertical object in his left hand. The figure on the right is a female with a crown, dressed in a robe with floral designs, holding a vertical object in her right hand. They are standing on a patterned floor, under a sun and a crescent moon, surrounded by radiant lines. The scene is enclosed within an ornate border.

artworks.title: Woman Weighing Pearls
artworks.medium: wood engraving on japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. John Farr Simmons
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing from the waist up, facing slightly to the left. She has a serene expression, with her head slightly inclined, looking down at an object she is holding. Her hair is covered by a white veil or headscarf. She is wearing a dark outer garment over lighter clothing, and appears to be holding a balance or scales in her right hand, weighing small objects, possibly pearls. The table in front of her is covered with a patterned cloth and there is a shallow bowl to the left of her hand. In the background, a large painting is partially visible on the wall and sunlight streams in from a window on the left.

artworks.title: Arab Mounting
artworks.medium: soft-etching and roulette
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Grey Froelich Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is an image of a regal horse with an individual mounted on it and another individual standing beside it, holding the reins. The horse has detailed features including a strong, muscular build and flowing mane. The horse is adorned with ornate tack. The mounted individual is dressed in a flowing, intricately patterned garment. The handler, standing beside the horse, is also garbed in similarly textured clothing. The drawing exhibits fine lines and cross-hatching, creating a sense of texture and depth, while the contrast between light and dark areas adds drama to the scene.

artworks.title: Anne and Her Mother
artworks.medium: black crayon and graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, a woman and a child, depicted from the waist up. The woman is slightly bent forward, engaging with the child seated beside her. The woman's facial features are delicately outlined, and she has her hair styled in a bun. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a patterned neckline. The child has a fringe haircut and wears a dark dress with a light collar. The woman holds a small object, possibly a book, angled towards the child. They are in front of a shaded window with decorative drapery on either side.

artworks.title: Study for "Mr. and Mrs. Philip Wase"
artworks.medium: black conté crayon on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: There is a drawing of two hands engaged in crafting or creating. The drawing features a pair of hands placed in the center of the composition. One hand is positioned slightly above the other. The hands seem to be interacting with folded pieces of material. Various geometric shapes and motifs decorate the lower part of the image. The artwork is executed in a monochrome palette, using strong lines to convey texture, volume, and shading. The artist used bold outlines and softer shading techniques to create a lively depiction of hands at work.

artworks.title: An Irish Girl
artworks.medium: black crayon
artworks.creditLine: Collection of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Mellon
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil drawing of a woman from the waist up. She is in profile, turning her head slightly towards the viewer. The woman's facial features are detailed, with a soft gaze. Her hair is styled and she wears a hat with decorations. Her dress has a high collar, long sleeves, and a voluminous skirt. She is wearing lace gloves. The background is plain, keeping the focus on the woman.
